reason: The README clearly describes a plugin for generating images from text with Baidu ERNIE-Image-Turbo, saving results locally, and inserting them into sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过百度 AI Studio 的 ERNIE-Image-Turbo 模型根据文本提示生成图片，并支持预览、下载和插入会话。
summaries.en: Generate images from text prompts with Baidu AI Studio's ERNIE-Image-Turbo model, with options to preview, download, and insert results into sessions.

capabilities: Generates images through the Baidu AI Studio ERNIE-Image-Turbo API
Writes generated PNG files to a local plugin directory
Registers generated images as session attachments for agent use
Stores and tests a user-provided API credential through the host credential store
